about_page.objective: Interviews play a crucial role in the job acquisition process. Interviewers typically not only assess a person's technical knowledge and abilities, but also their social skills. InterviewHelper aims to act as a self improvement assistant/tool that will help candidates better their non-verbal skills for upcoming interviews.

features.1: The main feature of InterviewHelper is the ability to take mock interviews. These mock interviews evaluate user's non-verbal performance using machine learning.
features.2: During a mock interview, a few metrics are evaluated. These include the user's eye contact with the camera, their facial expressions and their posture.
features.3: Users receive a higher score based on how confident they appear. Good posture, warm smiles and attentive eye contact leads to better score.
features.4: At the end of an interview, users are informed on what they can improve upon, based on their scores.
features.5: Users can also view their past interview scores to watch their improvement over time.
